reason: I only try what my sister-in-law or someone in my Zalo group already runs, and nobody I know uses this. The offer sounds fair, but I'm not putting my techs' pay and my card money on something nobody I trust has vouched for.
objection: Card fees are where the real money is. Is yours really cheaper, and who in my group is actually using it?
would_change_my_mind: My sister-in-law, or an owner I know from the Zalo group, tells me she runs it and her card fees went down. Then I would do the free fee check with my statements.
